what: TONER-1 Pro pretraining (config B), as saved in pretrain.pt: llama2.c train.py config after configurator overrides. The run went in 18 resumable chunks of about 8 minutes (max_wall_seconds 490). max_iters, which sets llama2.c's cosine schedule, was edited in pro_B.py during the run: 4200 for iters 1 to 224 (chunk 1), 4000 for iters 225 to 1314 (chunks 2 to 6), and 3800 from iter 1315 to the end (chunks 7 to 18).
command: python -I -u training/scripts/pro_train.py training/configs/pro_B.py   (first chunk), then the same with --init_from=resume until max_iters
